# Weyland-Yutani Corporate Handbook ## Field Operations Edition
[color=#a4885c]PROPRIETARY. Internal distribution only. Not for release to colonial, military or government personnel.[/color]
[italic]Building Better Worlds.[/italic]
Welcome to the Company.
This handbook sets out the standard operating procedure for Weyland-Yutani personnel at colonial sites. It covers the chain of command, the divisions, security, daily office procedure, and the Company's partnership with the colony it operates on.
Every employee is expected to know it. When a situation isn't covered here, act in the Company's interest and report it to your superior. When in doubt, say less.
Breaches of procedure are recorded in your personnel file and reviewed at contract renewal.
